verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI for decluttering feedback and finding impactful opportunities, a customer-facing support agent (Fibi), and a Reports API. None of these is a documented assistant that users can ask questions about feedback themes and their revenue impact. The decluttering AI is an adjacent feature, Fibi serves end customers rather than internal analysis, and the Reports API is a developer building block, so none of them earns credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant questions about customer feedback themes and their revenue impact
